# The top-level files of the Colab browser app, declared once. The native server's inventory
# (src/app_inventory.rs) and the packaging proof (typescript/scripts/colab-runtime-proof.mjs)
# both read this file; flat generated files live under assets/ and are not listed.
# `html` entries are required, served as HTML and may reference only listed assets.
# `text` entries are optional, plain-text files.
html index.html
html renderer.html
html reader.html
text THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
